item.title: github: EMU deletions fix
item.description:
GitHub fixed an issue where some Enterprise Managed User accounts deprovisioned via SCIM between June 1 and June 13, 2026 were deleted instead of being suspended and obfuscated. The notice describes the incorrect deletion behavior and the correction.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: SCIM user responses now include a profileUrl attribute
item.description:
GitHub SCIM user responses now include the RFC 7643 standard profileUrl attribute. It returns the absolute URL of the GitHub account linked to the external identity.

  • Source: GitHub
